scope: DGAF repository-local recurring assurance families; bounded partial catalog

known_gaps: Many current workflows, assurance scripts, governance tests, security checks, documentation audits, and historical audit families still require classification and mapping.

Current protected-main readback identifies PPTL CI, Governance CI, and PR Issue-State Keyword Guard as required contexts, but exact job/workflow/ruleset mapping and broader administration semantics remain incomplete for the catalog.
Shared-dependency and independence analysis remains incomplete across the wider assurance surface; some cataloged families intentionally reuse repository-local validators.
External-runtime ingress assurance on current main still requires dedicated catalog expansion and runtime evidence binding.
Historical dated audit reports still require family-versus-execution-instance classification.

audits.name: Governance CI
audits.assertion: Repository governance contracts and their declared verifier paths remain internally consistent for the exact candidate under test.
audits.decision_effect: May block acceptance of a repository candidate when the governance workflow fails within its declared scope.
non_effects: Does not establish scientific efficacy.
Does not by itself establish runtime deployment identity.
Does not grant experimental or High-Assurance authorization.
known_gaps: Workflow success is not independent external verification; exact requiredness depends on protected-branch/ruleset authority.

audits.name: PDMAL Pre-Freeze Runner Validation
audits.assertion: Pre-freeze runner and associated experiment-governance contracts satisfy their repository-defined structural and fail-closed checks.
audits.decision_effect: May block repository acceptance for candidates covered by the pre-freeze validation workflow.
non_effects: Does not itself establish freeze.
Does not authorize collection, materialization, unblinding, or primary analysis.
Does not increment scientific N.
known_gaps: Passing structural validation is not execution evidence for a scientific transition.

audits.name: Truth Layer Validation
audits.assertion: Current repository projections do not violate the declared truth-layer and control-state consistency contracts exercised by the workflow.
audits.decision_effect: May reject a repository candidate with a detected truth-layer inconsistency in the covered checks.
non_effects: Does not prove every claim in the repository true.
Does not create external corroboration or independent validation.
Does not establish runtime or scientific state beyond the checked projection semantics.
known_gaps: Coverage is bounded by implemented assertions and cannot be treated as exhaustive claim verification.

audits.name: Ecosystem Registry Audit
audits.assertion: The machine-readable ecosystem registry satisfies repository-defined projection, metadata, persona-authority, and claim-boundary invariants.
audits.decision_effect: May block a repository candidate whose ecosystem projection violates the implemented registry invariants.
non_effects: Does not make the ecosystem registry authoritative for project-local source/runtime truth.
Does not establish scientific efficacy or authorization.
known_gaps: Live provider facts remain provider-owned; the audit can only validate the evidence and projection inputs it receives.

audits.name: Exact-Source Live Runtime Verification
audits.assertion: A production runtime observation is bound to the exact deployed source identity and satisfies the declared health/regression/audit readback contract for that deployment event.
audits.decision_effect: May establish or reject exact-source runtime verification for a named deployment event when all required bindings and observations are present.
non_effects: Does not transfer runtime evidence to later source revisions.
Does not establish durable replay authority, scientific efficacy, independent validation, or experimental authorization.
known_gaps: Current source has advanced beyond the last fully reconciled historical runtime; #767 controls warning-contract reconciliation on a future exact-source deployment.

audits.name: Claim Hygiene Audit
audits.assertion: Repository claim surfaces satisfy the implemented claim-language, truth-layer reconciliation, canonical-parity, and registry-consistency checks for the candidate under test.
audits.decision_effect: Provides recurring repository claim-hygiene assurance evidence; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not establish scientific validity.
Does not establish production validity or runtime identity.
Does not grant authorization or independent validation.
known_gaps: Checks are bounded to implemented claim surfaces and validators; absence of a detected violation is not exhaustive claim verification.

audits.name: Control State Consistency
audits.assertion: Canonical control-state records satisfy the repository-defined consistency validator for the exact candidate under test.
audits.decision_effect: Surfaces a control-state consistency defect when the validator fails; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not authorize any governance transition.
Does not establish runtime deployment state.
Does not establish scientific efficacy or independent validation.
known_gaps: Consistency is limited to encoded validator rules and is not proof that every upstream factual input is externally correct.

audits.name: Critical PR Lane Custody
audits.assertion: Registered critical PR lanes preserve exact payload/head/base custody semantics and reject the workflow's defined negative-control violations.
audits.owner: DGAF critical PR lane custody workflow
audits.decision_effect: Provides custody assurance for covered registered PR lanes; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not authorize the PR or its downstream action.
Does not establish scientific, runtime, or High-Assurance state.
known_gaps: Coverage is limited to registered lanes and repository-visible custody inputs; successful custody validation is non-authorizing.

audits.name: Epistemic Evidence Validation
audits.assertion: Evidence-card, PDMAL structural, manifest, and instrumentation-only smoke checks satisfy their repository-defined validation contracts without performing inferential analysis.
audits.decision_effect: Provides bounded epistemic/instrumentation validation evidence; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not perform inferential analysis.
Does not establish E2b PASS when immutable transitive dependency locking is absent.
Does not establish efficacy, authorization, or scientific-N advancement.
known_gaps: Instrumentation smoke coverage is deliberately non-inferential and cannot substitute for experiment execution or independent validation.

audits.name: External Acceptance Readiness Validation
audits.assertion: Inert external-acceptance readiness templates and validators preserve the repository-defined readiness constraints and negative-control behavior.
audits.decision_effect: Validates the covered readiness artifacts and self-tests; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not establish external acceptance.
Does not activate or authorize an external integration.
Does not establish production, scientific, or High-Assurance state.
known_gaps: Readiness templates are inert; validation does not prove any external system has accepted, executed, or independently verified them.

audits.name: Full Repository Audit
audits.assertion: The repository-wide audit script completes its implemented cross-repository hygiene and consistency checks and emits a machine-readable audit artifact.
audits.decision_effect: Surfaces repository-wide audit findings within the implemented method; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not constitute independent external audit.
Does not establish scientific efficacy, runtime identity, certification, or authorization.
known_gaps: Coverage is bounded by scripts/full_repo_audit.py and its inputs; the name 'full' must not be interpreted as proof of exhaustive assurance coverage.

audits.name: IP and Public-Root Hygiene
audits.assertion: Public-root, citation/notice, secret-pattern, claim-hygiene, and portfolio-staleness checks execute with the workflow's declared hygiene semantics.
audits.decision_effect: Surfaces public-root/IP/claim hygiene defects or warnings within the implemented workflow; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not provide blanket security assurance.
Secret-pattern warnings are not proof that no secret exists.
Does not establish legal clearance, scientific validity, runtime identity, or authorization.
known_gaps: Reuses the repository claim-hygiene checker, creating a shared dependency; warning-only secret-pattern checks must not be promoted to fail-closed security assurance.
